floor9_glass_root_heart.text: The Glass Root hums with memory. When you press your palm to it, the cathedral learns your true shape.

choices.text: Awaken the Glass Root and return to the shrine.
Return to the Root Shrine.

floor9_blood_root_path.title: Floor 9 - Blood Root Path
floor9_blood_root_path.text: Red sap runs in channels along the floor. It pulses faster when you step near it, as if counting your heartbeats for later.

choices.text: sacrifice blood to claim the old power boon.
Refuse the sap and enter the battlefield clean.

floor9_sap_battlefield.title: Floor 9 - Sap Battlefield
floor9_sap_battlefield.text: Root-armored pilgrims rise from the sap. They do not hate you. They only remember guarding this place.

combat.name: Sapbound Pilgrims
combat.intro: The pilgrims lift wooden shields wet with red sap.
combat.victoryText: The sap calms and draws a red line toward the Blood Root.

floor9_blood_root_heart.title: Floor 9 - Blood Root Heart
floor9_blood_root_heart.text: The Blood Root coils around old weapons and newer bones. It drinks the last tremor of battle and accepts you.

choices.text: Awaken the Blood Root and return to the shrine.
Return to the Root Shrine.

floor9_ash_root_path.title: Floor 9 - Ash Root Path
floor9_ash_root_path.text: Ash falls upward here. Seeds crack open in the air, burn, and become seeds again before they touch the ground.

choices.text: take the ash boon and breathe the old power in.
Cover your mouth and cross the ash fall.

floor9_cinder_nursery.title: Floor 9 - Cinder Nursery
floor9_cinder_nursery.text: Tiny black trees grow from cracked helmets. The nursery wants decay, but it also wants someone careful enough to plant it correctly.

choices.text: replant the cinder nursery in living soil.
Let the ash choose its own pattern.

floor9_ash_root_heart.title: Floor 9 - Ash Root Heart
floor9_ash_root_heart.text: The Ash Root is warm, dead, and alive in the same breath. It blooms only after it forgives the fire.

choices.text: Awaken the Ash Root and return to the shrine.
Return to the Root Shrine.

floor9_saint_gate.title: Floor 9 - Saint Gate
floor9_saint_gate.text: Three roots braid across a sealed arch. Behind it, the Buried Saint breathes through the whole cathedral.

choices.text: Return to the Root Shrine.
Awaken all three Ancient Roots and open the Saint Gate.

floor9_boss.title: Floor 9 - The Buried Saint
floor9_boss.text: The Buried Saint unfolds from the altar, crowned in roots and half-remembered prayers. It was planted to guard the dungeon from itself. It has forgotten the difference between guard and jailer.

combat.name: The Buried Saint
combat.intro: The Buried Saint opens wooden eyes full of old power.
combat.victoryText: The Saint kneels into the soil. A seed remains where its heart should have been.

floor9_clear_room.title: Floor 9 Clear - The Cathedral Breathes
floor9_clear_room.text: With the Buried Saint gone, the Root Cathedral exhales through every wall. The old power is awake now, and Floor 10 waits below as a living dungeon with roots wrapped around its laws.

choices.text: Descend toward the living dungeon. [FLOOR 9 COMPLETE]

floor10_coliseum_antechamber.title: Floor 10 - Coliseum Antechamber
floor10_coliseum_antechamber.text: The Coliseum Below waits under a ceiling of root-wrapped stone. The dungeon is no longer hiding its hunger; it has built seats for it. The rule is painted in gold across the gate: 10 wins open the Grand Arbiter.

choices.text: Rest on the contender bench.
Buy a large potion from the arena medic. (65 gold)
Step to the Arena Board.

floor10_arena_board.title: Floor 10 - Arena Board
floor10_arena_board.text: Bronze nameplates crawl across the board as the crowd changes its mind about who deserves to live. Ten champion bouts stand between you and the Grand Arbiter.

choices.text: claim the crowd favor by saluting the pit.
study the Arbiter from old bout records.
swear on the blood sand before the crowd.
Bout 1: challenge Mirehand Korr.
Bout 2: challenge Velka of the Split Mask.
Bout 3: challenge Brassjaw Oren.
Bout 4: challenge Candle Knight.
Bout 5: challenge Sable Choir Twins.
Bout 6: challenge Red Ledger Mara.
Bout 7: challenge Old Thorn Brakus.
Bout 8: challenge Glass-Eye Toma.
Bout 9: challenge The Ninth Roar.
Bout 10: challenge Crownless Vey.
Approach the Final Gate.

floor10_final_gate.title: Floor 10 - Final Gate
floor10_final_gate.text: The final gate is a wall of raised weapons. Each Coliseum Win burns as a notch of light along the bars.

choices.text: Return to the Arena Board.
Present 10 Coliseum Wins and call the Grand Arbiter.

floor10_boss.title: Floor 10 - The Grand Arbiter
floor10_boss.text: The Grand Arbiter descends through the roar, carrying a judge blade and a crown made from broken champion tags. It does not ask whether you are worthy. It asks whether the crowd is finished with you.

combat.name: The Grand Arbiter
combat.intro: The Grand Arbiter raises the judge blade. The coliseum falls silent.
combat.victoryText: The judge blade breaks. For the first time, the crowd has no verdict.

floor10_clear_room.title: Floor 10 Clear - The Crowd Has No Verdict
floor10_clear_room.text: The Coliseum Below empties itself into silence. The Grand Arbiter is beaten, the crown is yours, and this is the end of the current arc. Whatever waits beneath this place will have to learn a new name for you.

choices.text: Stand alone in the coliseum. [FLOOR 10 COMPLETE]

floor10_bout_1.title: Floor 10 - Bout 1: Mirehand Korr
floor10_bout_1.text: The pit gates grind open for Bout 1. Mirehand Korr steps into the sand with a champion's patience and a killer's timing.

combat.name: Mirehand Korr
combat.intro: Mirehand Korr answers the bell for Bout 1.
combat.victoryText: Bout 1 is yours. The board brands another win into your record.

floor10_bout_2.text: The pit gates grind open for Bout 2. Velka of the Split Mask steps into the sand with a champion's patience and a killer's timing.

combat.name: Velka of the Split Mask
combat.intro: Velka of the Split Mask answers the bell for Bout 2.
combat.victoryText: Bout 2 is yours. The board brands another win into your record.

combat.name: Brassjaw Oren
combat.intro: Brassjaw Oren answers the bell for Bout 3.
combat.victoryText: Bout 3 is yours. The board brands another win into your record.

floor10_bout_4.text: The pit gates grind open for Bout 4. The Candle Knight steps into the sand with a champion's patience and a killer's timing.

combat.name: The Candle Knight
combat.intro: The Candle Knight answers the bell for Bout 4.
combat.victoryText: Bout 4 is yours. The board brands another win into your record.

floor10_bout_5.text: The pit gates grind open for Bout 5. Sable Choir Twins steps into the sand with a champion's patience and a killer's timing.

combat.intro: Sable Choir Twins answers the bell for Bout 5.
combat.victoryText: Bout 5 is yours. The board brands another win into your record.

floor10_bout_6.text: The pit gates grind open for Bout 6. Red Ledger Mara steps into the sand with a champion's patience and a killer's timing.

combat.name: Red Ledger Mara
combat.intro: Red Ledger Mara answers the bell for Bout 6.
combat.victoryText: Bout 6 is yours. The board brands another win into your record.

floor10_bout_7.text: The pit gates grind open for Bout 7. Old Thorn Brakus steps into the sand with a champion's patience and a killer's timing.

combat.name: Old Thorn Brakus
combat.intro: Old Thorn Brakus answers the bell for Bout 7.
combat.victoryText: Bout 7 is yours. The board brands another win into your record.

floor10_bout_8.text: The pit gates grind open for Bout 8. Glass-Eye Toma steps into the sand with a champion's patience and a killer's timing.

combat.name: Glass-Eye Toma
combat.intro: Glass-Eye Toma answers the bell for Bout 8.
combat.victoryText: Bout 8 is yours. The board brands another win into your record.

floor10_bout_9.text: The pit gates grind open for Bout 9. The Ninth Roar steps into the sand with a champion's patience and a killer's timing.

combat.name: The Ninth Roar
combat.intro: The Ninth Roar answers the bell for Bout 9.
combat.victoryText: Bout 9 is yours. The board brands another win into your record.

floor10_bout_10.text: The pit gates grind open for Bout 10. Crownless Vey steps into the sand with a champion's patience and a killer's timing.

combat.intro: Crownless Vey answers the bell for Bout 10.
combat.victoryText: Bout 10 is yours. The board brands another win into your record.
